sources.source: MTR Corporation Investor Relations Monthly Patronage
sources.notes: Monthly patronage counts and daily averages by rail service: Domestic, Airport Express, Cross-boundary (Lo Wu & Lok Ma Chau), Light Rail & Bus, and High Speed Rail (HSR).

sources.source: CAD HKIA Monthly Airport Traffic & Cathay Pacific IR Traffic Figures (PDF)
sources.notes: HKIA airport monthly aircraft movements, passenger volume, and freight tonnage alongside Cathay Pacific passengers, RPK, ASK, and Passenger Load Factor (%), fetched directly from Cathay's own investor-relations traffic-figures PDF (deterministic per-month URL).

sources.source: China Listed Airlines Monthly Operating Data
sources.notes: Monthly passengers, ASK, RPK and passenger load factor for Air China, China Southern, China Eastern and Spring Airlines, split by domestic, international and regional operations.

sources.source: Transport Department Monthly Traffic and Transport Digest — Table 2.1
sources.notes: Monthly public transport passenger journeys ('000s) by operator: KMB, Citybus, LWB, NLB (franchised buses), MTR heavy rail, Airport Express, Light Rail, Tramways, public light buses, ferries, taxis, and the territory-wide total.

sources.source: Transport Department Monthly Traffic and Transport Digest — Table 2.3
sources.notes: Monthly passenger journeys ('000s) for MTRC rail lines and franchised-bus operators, with HK Island, Kowloon/New Territories and cross-harbour geography where reported. Publication lags the current month by roughly two to three months.

sources.source: C&SD Table E705 — Cross-Boundary Aircraft, Vessel, Vehicle and Train Movements
sources.notes: Monthly inward and outward movements of aircraft, ocean/river/cargo vessels, goods/passenger vehicles and passenger trains. Some latest-year cells may be provisional estimates or N.A.; monthly history begins in 2023 in the current workbook.

sources.source: Transport Department Registration and Licensing of Vehicles — Table 4.1(a), Private Cars
sources.notes: Monthly private car fleet stock (total registered and licensed) split by fuel type -- Petrol, Electric, Diesel, Other -- the basis for the EV road-fleet registered-share chart.

sources.source: Transport Department Net First Registration of Private Cars — Table 4.1(c)
sources.notes: Monthly gross first registrations, deregistrations (all reasons, per TD's own header -- not scrappage specifically) and net first registration of private cars.

sources.source: Transport Department Monthly Private-Car First Registrations by Make and Fuel
sources.notes: Monthly first registrations of private cars by make, fuel type, first-registration status and body type; a genuine time series from May 2016 onward.

sources.source: Transport Department Latest Private-Car First-Registration Make/Model Details
sources.notes: Latest available monthly private-car make/model detail; used as a bounded lookup snapshot, while the make/fuel history above supplies the time-series chart.
Current vacancy by participating car park, vehicle type and vacancy status; the collection script appends snapshots for a genuine high-frequency history and does not treat unknown vacancy as zero.

Observed occupancy rate for sensor-backed metered/on-street parking spaces. The static inventory supplies the listed-space denominator and the live CSV marks each observed space occupied or vacant; sample_size and listed_spaces remain visible because a small number of status rows may be unmatched.
